verdicts.reason: A has real collisions: the RSVP button and the badge pills sit on top of the phone graphic, which is also cropped behind them. The decorative circle is left as an empty blob on the left, the legal line is microscopic, and the CTA and date details are split between two distant columns. B is a readable three-column banner (brand and headline / date, badges, CTA / phone) with no overlap on the CTA. Its flaws: the headline is jammed against the left edge, the middle column is cramped, the legal text is tiny, and the placeholder image crowds the phone's edge.
